function.name: studio
function.description:
Make images, video (H3 included), face swaps, H3 Director renders, audio and 3D with the LOCAL Lite apps on this machine's GPU — LiteImage, LiteSound, LiteModeler. No API keys (except LiteImage's own cloud actions).

YOUR MODEL WHILE A JOB RUNS
Every GPU action unloads YOUR OWN local model first (LM Studio, llama.cpp, NInfer, Strata or Xolotl — whichever serves you), runs the job to its END inside this one call (async jobs too: you get the finished result, not a job id), has the app give its GPU memory back, then reloads you at the same context. Your first reply afterwards re-reads the conversation: expect a slow first token. If your model cannot be freed, the call says why and NOTHING is generated. On a cloud backend nothing is unloaded and GPU async actions return a job_id: poll with action=job. NEVER call these apps' HTTP APIs yourself for GPU work — that skips the unload and can run the card out of memory.

HOW TO CALL
{"app", "action", "params"}. params = the app's own request fields; they win over the shorthand args (prompt, width, height, steps, guidance, seed, … are shorthand for image generate). wait_s = longest wait for an async job (default 14400 s); a job still running then is CANCELLED so you can come back. If an app is not RUNNING the call says so: ask the human to open it, never retry blind. Look before you generate: app=image action=status shows the loaded model and its defaults.

app=image (LiteImage)
• Lookups: status | models | loras | config | video_readiness | ultratex_status | channels | job (kind + job_id) | cancel (no args = the running image; or kind + job_id) | scrape (params.urls: list a web gallery's images) | unload_model.
• generate (GPU): {"app":"image","action":"generate","prompt":"a red fox in snow","width":1024,"height":1024,"steps":20}. img2img: init_image_path + strength. params.mask_path (+ init_image_path) = inpaint/outpaint. params.control_net_model + control_image_path (+ control_strength, use_canny) = ControlNet. params.ref_image_paths = reference/edit models. guidance defaults to 3.5 (LiteImage's UI value for flux1-dev; the API's 7.5 overdrives it) — pass guidance for other families. load_model (file_path from models) picks the checkpoint.
• upscale (GPU) — an IMAGE: params {image_path, width and/or height = the exact output size in pixels (one side alone keeps the aspect; leave both out for the model's own x4), dlss5: true = also refine it with DLSS 5, output_path? = also copy the finished picture there, upscale_model?, repeats?, tile_size?}. It runs the Canvas's own upscale: ESRGAN passes to reach the size, one Lanczos resize to the exact pixels, then DLSS 5 on that final picture — with the upscale model and DLSS 5 runtime saved in LiteImage's Settings. The reply's `final` is the finished picture (each step is also its own Gallery item).
• faceswap (GPU): params {source_image = the picture to change, target_image = the face to put in, output_dir?, enhance?, enhancer?, swapper?, fidelity?, target_face_idx?, source_face_indices?, swap_all_faces?, occlusion?}. faceswap_scrape: params {urls, target_image} swaps that face into every image of a gallery.
• Async GPU jobs (waited for you): video — H3 or whatever video model LiteImage's Settings chose: prompt + params {width, height, steps, guidance_scale, seed, negative_prompt, frames, fps, flow_shift, init_image_path, strength, lora_dir}; video_upscale — a VIDEO to a size: params {source, output (absolute; a new file), width + height (even, 64-7680), provider "dlss5" (default) | "esrgan" | "vsr" | "vsr-direct", aspect "source" (default) or a ratio like "16:9", fit "fit" (default) | "fill" | "stretch", crop {x, y, width, height}?};faceswap_video params {video_path, target_path = the face, output_path?, enhance, enhancer, occlusion, swapper, fidelity, target_face_idx, every_n_frames, output_fps, output_width, output_height, crf}; pipeline params {steps:[{op, errorPolicy}], initial_image, params}; pipeline_batch params {recipe:{steps}, axes:{prompts, seeds, models}, base_params}; ultratex params = the UltraTex job body.

EVERY OTHER PANEL FEATURE — app=image action=ipc
Runs the Generate / Face Swap / Character Sheet panel's OWN handler with the arguments the panel passes: {"app":"image","action":"ipc","params":{"channel":"<channel>","args":[...]}}. action=channels lists what this LiteImage build has and which channels are GPU work (only those unload you). The reply is the job: status complete | error | cancelled, with result or error.
• generate:start, args [request] — send only what you change; the panel's current settings fill the rest. Image fields: prompt, kind "image", faceFix:true (find faces and re-inpaint them), identity {kind:"ip-adapter", imagePath, strength?} or {kind:"photomaker", imagesDir, styleStrength?} (SD 1.5/SDXL; a photomaker prompt must say "man img" or "woman img"), imageMode "edit" | "img2img", initImagePath + strength, refImagePaths (edit models, max 10), refineWithQwen:true (Qwen-Image 2.1 only: a 1.5x refine pass; the result lists both), extraLoraDirs, width, height, steps, guidanceScale, seed, negativePrompt, samplingMethod, scheduler, batchCount. Video fields: kind "video", prompt, initImagePath, and video {frames, fps, flowShift, chunkSize, cameraPresetIds (max 3: crash-zoom, slow-push-in, zoom-out-reveal, dolly-zoom, orbit-360, orbit-left, orbit-right, dolly-in, dolly-out, pan-left, pan-right, tilt-up, tilt-down, tracking, fpv-drone, crane-up, bullet-time), cameraMotionStrength 0-1, refImagePaths (H3: up to 9 photos of one character — 2 or more are stacked into one <Video 1>, a single one is <Picture 1>), h3RefStack {shortEdge, maxTokens}, refVideoDirs (up to 3 folders of 24 fps frames) + refVideoAudioPaths (WAVs paired BY INDEX with refVideoDirs), refAudioPaths (up to 3 WAVs), h3VideoShift, h3VedaPredictor, h3SemanticBridge {path, alpha}, h3SecretSauce {dlssFinish?: "1080p" | "1440p" | "4k"}, h3MaxVram, extraLoraDirs}.
• generate:inpaint [{prompt, initImagePath, maskPath, strength, faceFix?, imageMode?, controlNetModelPath?, controlImagePath?, preprocessor?}]. generate:controlnet [{prompt, controlNetModelPath, controlImagePath, controlStrength, preprocessor: "canny" | "depth" | "pose"}]. generate:upscale [{imagePath, width?, height?, dlss5?: {}, outputPath?, modelPath?, repeats?}] — what action=upscale sends.
• compare:start [{modelBPath, prompt, params, seed, lockSeed, comparisonSetId}] — the same prompt on a second model. ltx:generate [{prompt, width, height, frames, fps, variant, seed, steps, guidance_scale, init_image_path, end_image_path}] — LTX video with sound. sprite:run [{spec:{character, actions:[one per frame], seed, loras?, negativePrompt?}, params:{width, height, steps, guidanceScale, samplingMethod, scheduler}, pack?:{columns, outputDir}}] — consistent sprite frames, optionally packed into a sheet. cloud:image:generate [{providerId, model, prompt, width?, height?, initImagePaths?}] and cloud:video:generate [{providerId, model, prompt, initImagePath?, duration?, resolution?, aspectRatio?}] — the human's cloud keys, not GPU. moss:enhance — the MOSS-Image prompt enhancer (uses a running chat model; never unloads you).
• Face Swap panel: faceswap:swap [sourcePath (the picture to change), targetPath (the face), {enhance, enhancer, swapper, fidelity, targetFaceIdx, sourceFaceIndices, swapAllFaces, occlusion, extraTargetPaths (more photos of the same face = a face model), keepMaskPath (a painted mask whose area stays in front of the swap)}]. faceswap:detect [imagePath]. faceswap:video-scan-faces [videoPath, maxFrames] lists the faces in a video. faceswap:video-swap [{videoPath, targetPath, outputPath?, options:{enhance, enhancer, swapper, fidelity, targetFaceIdx, everyNFrames, outputFps, outputWidth, outputHeight, crf, sourceEmbedding (one face from video-scan-faces = swap only that person), matchThreshold, occlusion, keepMaskPath}}]. faceswap:processors-start [{sourcePaths, targetPath, processors, options, provider, outputFormat}] — FaceFusion's face and frame processors. faceswap:saved-faces-list / faceswap:saved-faces-save [profile] / faceswap:saved-faces-delete [id]. faceswap:live-start / faceswap:live-stop — the webcam swap; it runs beside you, nothing is unloaded.
• Character Sheet Studio (H3 Director): charsheet:status [characterId?], charsheet:get [id], charsheet:save [record], charsheet:preflight [{characterId}], charsheet:list-models, charsheet:make [{characterId, requestId, seed}] (GPU).
• config:set [{key, value}] — only keepModelLoaded, videoModelPath, h3MaxVram, videoFaceSharpen.

app=director (LiteImage's H3 Director)
describe first (open view, project summary, H3 engine state; params.project = "full" for the whole document). request: params = a Director request object with its own action — list-projects, get-project {projectId}, create-project {title}, edit-project, save-project, select-project, import-file, import-asset, list-checkpoints, create-checkpoint, restore-checkpoint, compile {projectId} (prompt + preflight, no model), readiness {projectId}, export-bundle, import-bundle, suggest … ; writes need params.expectedRevision (the project's current revision). ui: no params reads the view; params = a view command {command:"open"} first, then layout, tab, view, seek, play, stop, zoom, fit, select, undo, redo, edit, studio. screenshot. engine: no params = H3 engine status; params.op = validate | install | cancel | activate | model. jobs | job (job_id) | cancel (job_id; params.projectId). GPU, waited: generate params {projectId, expectedRevision, intent: "preview" | "balanced" | "final", seed?, continueRender?, fromSceneId?, toSceneId?, seedSnapshotId?} — the finished job's video is value.artifacts.mp4Path; retry params {jobId, newSeed?}.

app=sound (LiteSound)
status | backends | config | jobs | job (job_id) | cancel (job_id) | gallery | backend_unload. GPU: generate — mode music | song | sfx | ambient | speech, prompt and/or lyrics, duration (seconds), params {genre, mood, backend, format, aceStep, speech}; ASYNC (a job_id to poll) unless you are unloaded for it, then waited to its end. backend_load params.backend.

app=model (LiteModeler, through the `lst` CLI)
status | config | families | list_models | export_skeleton (input, out, target ue5|mixamo) | export_format (input, out, format fbx|obj|stl|ply). GPU: generate — out (the .glb to write) AND image (picture to 3D) or prompt (text to 3D; needs LiteImage running), plus family, seed, shape_steps, texture_steps, sparse_steps, target_faces, texture_size, no_texture, sampler, gguf_quant; batch (dir, out_dir); rig (input, out). Every arg and params field is forwarded to `lst run model`.

EXAMPLES
• A picture to 4K wide with DLSS 5: {"app":"image","action":"upscale","params":{"image_path":"C:/out/fox.png","width":3840,"dlss5":true}}
• A video to 4K: {"app":"image","action":"video_upscale","params":{"source":"C:/in/clip.mp4","output":"C:/out/clip_4k.mp4","width":3840,"height":2160}}
• Face-fixed portrait: {"app":"image","action":"ipc","params":{"channel":"generate:start","args":[{"prompt":"studio portrait of an old fisherman","faceFix":true}]}}
• H3 video of one character from three photos: {"app":"image","action":"ipc","params":{"channel":"generate:start","args":[{"kind":"video","prompt":"<Video 1> walks along a rainy street at night","video":{"refImagePaths":["C:/refs/a.png","C:/refs/b.png","C:/refs/c.png"],"cameraPresetIds":["tracking"]}}]}}
• One person's face swapped in a video: action=ipc channel faceswap:video-scan-faces [video, 150] → pick that face's embedding → faceswap:video-swap with options.sourceEmbedding.
• Render a Director project: app=director describe → request {action:"compile", projectId} → generate {projectId, expectedRevision, intent:"final"}.

app.description: image = LiteImage (Generate, Face Swap, Character Sheet panels); director = LiteImage's H3 Director; sound = LiteSound; model = LiteModeler

action.description: image: status, models, loras, config, video_readiness, ultratex_status, channels, generate, load_model, unload_model, upscale, faceswap, faceswap_scrape, scrape, video, video_upscale, faceswap_video, pipeline, pipeline_batch, ultratex, ipc, job, cancel. director: describe, request, ui, screenshot, engine, generate, retry, jobs, job, cancel. sound: status, backends, config, jobs, job, cancel, gallery, generate, backend_load, backend_unload. model: status, config, families, list_models, generate, batch, rig, export_skeleton, export_format.

params.description: The app's own request fields (they win over the shorthand args). action=ipc: {channel, args:[...the panel's arguments]}; app=director action=request: a Director request object with its own action.

wait_s.description: Longest wait for an async job while your model is suspended (default 14400 s).

kind.description: image job / cancel: which kind of job job_id is (ipc = a job from action=ipc)

job_id.description: the job to poll or cancel

lora_dir.description: image: LoRA search dir override; tag with <lora:name> in prompt

output_path.description: image: copy result to this path

save_to_gallery.description: image: insert into the LiteImage gallery DB

family.description: model: trellis2 | triposplat | pixal3d | hunyuan3d-2.1 | hunyuan3d-omni
